_comment: Fused-body standalone strike clips (M39-V2 Phase 5 gap-fix, Kyle 2026-08-30). Numbers-vocab body-shot tokens (1b..6b) rendered as ONE fused utterance per [[feedback-fused-bee-pronunciation]] — hyphenated 'One-bee' text is the input format Chatterbox needs to fuse letter+number as a fast single utterance (space / concat / comma / ellipsis all fail; hard-won). These replace the on-the-fly ['digit','body'] compose that dispatchPerWordCall does today — that compose violates the A/B/C rule because the split gives the boxer time to commit head shot before 'body' arrives to redirect. Filenames match the runtime asset id shape: 1b.wav .. 6b.wav in assets/voice/numbers/standalone/. Ids are frozen. Runtime consumer: comboPhraseAssets returns '2b' as a single VoiceAssetId for numbers-vocab body tokens (vocabulary.ts change coming in Step 3). Rendered push+shout — a single hit anchor, matching the existing 1.wav..6b.wav numbers standalone corpus.
